build_observer: build an Observer instance to render a MuJoCo environment with a configurable 3D viewer window
build_observer_with_defaults: build an Observer using the classmethod build with default 640x480 window size and title
set_camera_config: set the camera_config property to adjust lookat, distance, azimuth, and elevation for the viewer
begin_episode: begin an episode by initializing the Viewer and OffScreenRenderer for the environment physics model
step_render: call step to update the render window and apply pending camera configuration changes
